reasons: The five-session rule was discovered in a wider retrospective search; this focused family cannot turn that discovery into independent validation.
The frozen rule loses incremental return in 2025, including the single worst embargoed intervention episode.
The focused 48-member bootstrap is only a lower bound on the wider lifetime search multiplicity.
A one-extra-session-lag negative control reverses the selection-prefix and full-calendar edge, so the timing result is not robust.
Every historical session was already development-visible, so none is a pristine holdout.
The legacy active comparator is bound, but there is no trusted writer, external chronology seal, or outcome-independent terminal date.

signalContract.selectedRule: strict full veto when sign(selected gas position) times the prior five-session compounded UNG adjusted-close return divided by prior up-to-20-session daily sample standard deviation times sqrt(5) is greater than 1
signalContract.targetSessionReturnUse: never; the context is built before appending the current session return
signalContract.expandingInceptionWindow: The historical discovery used up to 20 prior returns at comparator inception; the first selected-rule veto occurs only after 20 prior observations.

selectedShadow.selectionCaveat: Rank is descriptive sensitivity information only. The focused family neither selected nor promoted this previously discovered rule.

multipleTesting.scopeCaveat: Focused-family lower bound only: the adjustment covers all 48 UNG exhaustion rows, but not the wider prior 388-row market-state search, the later 480-row cross-market search, the active comparator, or the lifetime QORE search.

pboNonCalibratedDiagnostic.method: 10-block combinatorially symmetric cross-validation with a 10-session embargo
pboNonCalibratedDiagnostic.interpretationWarning: PBO is a non-calibrated rank diagnostic, not a posterior probability that the discovered rule is overfit or safe.

selectionPrefix.method: Changed targets within 10 sessions share an episode; attribution runs through one session after the final changed target.

fullCalendar.method: Changed targets within 10 sessions share an episode; attribution runs through one session after the final changed target.

deletionRobustness.method: Delete the named calendar or component-season rows from the aligned incremental-return series; do not retune or reselect.

temporalNegativeControl.rule: apply the exact frozen rule with one additional completed-session lag
temporalNegativeControl.purpose: Checks whether the result depends narrowly on the immediately preceding adjusted-close return.

episodeRobustness.method: Changed targets within 10 sessions share an episode; attribution runs through one session after the final changed target.

matchedFallbackRealityCheck.comparator: 98%-deployed VOO/QQQM basket replayed through the same execution simulator
